deeper.title: What the price assumes
deeper.text: The price assumes about 16% a year growth in free cash flow for 10 years, then 3% (discount rate 9.9% = 10-year Treasury 4.9% + 5%; base: last 12 months of free cash flow). For comparison, sales grew 20% last year; 5%/yr over 3 years — roughly in line with its recent growth.

deeper.title: Return on capital
deeper.text: 30% (3 years ago 37%, falling) — each $100 invested in the business (debt + equity, net of cash) earns about $30 a year after tax; return on shareholders' equity 37% (3 years ago 43%).

deeper.title: Multi-year view
deeper.text: Sales grew 5%/yr over 3 years and 3%/yr over 5 years; operating margin today 41% vs a 5-year range of 34–52% (median 40%): in the middle of its range.
deeper.margin_position: in the middle of its range

deeper.title: Cash returned to shareholders
deeper.text: Returned $5.8B to shareholders over the last 12 months ($636M buybacks + $5.2B dividends) = 2.1% of the company's market value. Share count up 0.8% from a year ago (stock pay outpacing buybacks — dilution).

deeper.title: Analyst estimates
deeper.text: Next year's earnings-per-share estimate $11.58, up 15% in 90 days (up 14% in the last 30); 24 analysts raised, 0 cut in 30 days. This year's earnings-per-share estimate $9.06, up 7% in 90 days (up 6% in the last 30); 23 analysts raised, 0 cut in 30 days. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

deeper.title: Where sales come from
deeper.text: By segment, latest quarter vs a year earlier: Analog 81% of sales, up 32%; Embedded Processing 14% of sales, up 21%; Other 5% of sales, down 6%. Source: 10-Q XBRL.

tiles.title: Earnings per share
tiles.sub: +77% vs a year ago · $7.72 over 12 months (GAAP)
tiles.read: Profit per share grew 77% vs sales 28% (latest quarter vs a year earlier): profits are outgrowing sales, so margins are widening.
tiles.explain: EPS = profit divided by the number of shares. The quarterly figures are the 'adjusted' EPS analysts track (Yahoo); the 12-month figure is the official GAAP number from SEC filings.

tiles.title: Earnings vs forecasts
tiles.sub: last 8 reports · bars = EPS beat (+) or miss (−) vs the average forecast
tiles.read: Beat forecasts 3 quarters running by about 10%, yet the stock fell after 4 of them: beats are already expected.
tiles.explain: A 'beat' means reported EPS came in above the average analyst forecast. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

tiles.title: Sales growth
tiles.sub: latest quarter +28% vs a year earlier · 12-month sales $20.8B
tiles.read: Latest quarter: sales up 28% vs a year earlier and speeding up (from 19% two quarters ago): demand is strengthening.
tiles.explain: Headline: sales over the last 12 months vs the 12 months before. Bars: each quarter's sales vs the same quarter a year earlier.

tiles.title: Profit margins
tiles.read: Each $100 of sales leaves $41 of operating profit, up from $34 a year ago: profitability is improving.
tiles.explain: Operating margin = operating profit ÷ sales. Gross margin = what's left after the direct cost of the product.

tiles.title: Free cash flow
tiles.read: It turned 103% of its reported profit into spare cash: the profits are real money, not just accounting.
tiles.explain: Free cash flow = cash from operations minus spending on equipment and buildings: money the company could return or reinvest.

tiles.title: Price vs profits (P/E)
tiles.read: You pay 40× last year's profit (higher than 92% of the last 5 years); only 27× next year's forecast, so the market expects profits to jump.
tiles.explain: P/E = share price ÷ earnings per share. Forward P/E uses next year's forecast earnings.

tiles.title: Next earnings
tiles.read: Reports Jan 26; analysts expect EPS of $2.66, up 110% from a year ago. It usually moves about 8% the day after, so expect a swing.
tiles.explain: Consensus = the average analyst forecast (Yahoo, unofficial). The typical move is the average size of the stock's next-day move after its last reports, not an options-implied figure.

tiles.title: Company outlook
tiles.read: No numeric outlook was found in the latest earnings release, so the next report carries more surprise risk.
tiles.explain: Guidance = what management says it expects for the next quarter or year, from its 8-K earnings release.

tiles.title: Forecast changes
